name: Anahata / Ashtanga Yoga in Bucharest (Irene Zaarour)
reason: Too thin and unclear as a school. anahata.ro (robots.txt allows us) is Irene Zaarour's teaching site, titled only "Ashtanga Yoga in Bucharest-Romania"; her weekly Mysore and led classes meet at "Altar" Yoga Shala, Strada Grivitei 6, which the site does not present as her own school, and no class prices are published. The other items are a mountain cabin in Pestera (Brasov) used for summer workshops since 2005 with no upcoming dates (the June 2026 Susanna Finocchi course has passed) and a PDF of a third party's Yoga Sutra translation. Fewer than three usable items, so skipped; she could suit an individual listing later.
